why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for Lars Nootbaar is slot #1 (4.372 expected team runs/game).
Slots #1, #3, #2, #4, #5, #6, #7, #8, #9 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #5 ranks 5 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.004 R/G.
Slot #1 yields 4.67 expected PA/game vs 4.23 at primary slot #5. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
